name: ryukami-ui
description: Retro TUI & Neo-Brutalist Component Library + CLI Installer & MCP Server (35 Modules) inspired by Velgrynd Scorch Lore. Built with Astro 7, Tailwind CSS 4 & TypeScript 7.
author: Ryukami Labs (Alecwce)

scripts.pages:dev: pnpm build && npx --yes wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.pages:deploy: pnpm build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=ryukami-ui --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.hooks:setup:
node -e 'fs.writeFileSync(".git/hooks/pre-push", "#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "[RYUKAMI AUTO-DEPLOY] Compilando 35 modulos + Astro y desplegando a Cloudflare Pages..."
if pnpm run pages:deploy; then
  echo "[RYUKAMI AUTO-DEPLOY] Produccion sincronizada en https://ryukami-ui.pages.dev"
else
  echo "[RYUKAMI AUTO-DEPLOY] Advertencia: Despliegue directo no disponible (auth/red), continuando push."
fi
"); fs.chmodSync(".git/hooks/pre-push", 0o755); console.log("[OK] Hook de Auto-Deploy pre-push instalado con tolerancia a fallos");'
